name: Muhammad Ali
hook: The boxer Jeopardy asks about most: the name change, the Rumble in the Jungle, the Fight of the Century.

facts.label: Cassius Clay
facts.statement: He was born Cassius Clay in Louisville and won 1960 Olympic light-heavyweight gold under that name.

facts.label: the name change
facts.statement: After converting to Islam he dropped Cassius Clay and became Muhammad Ali.

facts.label: Rumble in the Jungle
facts.statement: Stripped of his title in 1967, he won it back by knocking out George Foreman in 1974's Rumble in the Jungle in Zaire, using the rope-a-dope.

facts.label: Joe Frazier
facts.statement: He lost the 1971 "Fight of the Century" to Joe Frazier at Madison Square Garden, then won the 1974 and 1975 rematches.

facts.label: Sonny Liston
facts.statement: He called Sonny Liston "The Bear" before their 1964 title bout, then needed less than two minutes to beat him in the 1965 rematch.

facts.label: Leon Spinks
facts.statement: Leon Spinks upset him in 1978; Ali took the rematch, the last title fight he won.

facts.label: Parkinson's and his funeral
facts.statement: He campaigned on Capitol Hill for Parkinson's research, and Will Smith and Lennox Lewis were pallbearers at his 2016 funeral.
